summary: Crank Fizzlebub has found that Zanzil's Mixture blended into stout makes a strong drink, called Fool's Stout. He thinks it will be just what Kravel needs. You carry it to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, and quickly, because it will not stay fresh.

sections.title: A Libation for Kravel
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub has found that Zanzil's Mixture, blended into stout, gives a strong drink, the Fool's Stout. Crank thinks it will be just what Kravel needs, and wants to hear how it works. You carry it back to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Do Not Let It Sit
sections.body: Crank warns you against holding on to the stout for long. The mixture has an odd effect on the stout's yeast, pushing it into high gear, so the drink will not keep fresh forever.

faq.q: Who sends you on this delivery?
aliases: who starts zanzil's mixture and a fool's stout
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay gives you the Fool's Stout to carry.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why does the drink need to be delivered quickly?
faq.answer: Because the mix pushes the yeast hard, and stout that sits too long goes off.
It follows Back to Booty Bay and Zanzil's Secret.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the stout?
faq.answer: The chain continues with Fool's Stout, Get the Gnomes Drunk and Get the Goblins Drunk.
